name: m4t3
description: Company growth week (SPEC §2.7 / issue #58): an eight-Pop village charters 'Deepvein Combine' (focus metal) over one mining camp working a rich iron vein, sets a 100% branch share and AUTO-APPROVE expansion, then watches the company propose and execute a SECOND mining camp beside the sector's unclaimed node — paid from its own virtual treasury at the exact market-value price (wood 100 × value 1 ⇒ 100000 milli), sited by the AI's distance-sorted scorer around that node, Branch status attached at site birth. Meanwhile three directly-owned kitchens churn out profitable meals until the DAILY organic scan finds the sector ripe and an 'industrious' Pop founds '& Co.' spontaneously, absorbing all three kitchens as Branches under a free-dissolve grace window — exercised mid-run by a dissolveCompany command that reverts every kitchen cleanly without touching the owner's gold. Fixture pins milestone digests every 150th tick plus a legible treasury/branch/company trace, the §2.7 acceptance beats (auto expansion from treasury at exact price, organic founding under exact thresholds, grace-window free dissolution), and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
